title: The Last Person Who Remembers Meera

shots.visual_event: Meera enters her home; her father politely asks who she is while her own photographs show an empty space beside Arin.
shots.dialogue_audio: Father: “Can I help you?” Meera: “No. I’m sorry.”

shots.visual_event: At Platform 13, Maya forgets Meera mid-sentence; Saira immediately says Meera’s name and restores the recognition for one breath.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Meera Rao. Twelve. Teal coat. Saved her brother.”

shots.visual_event: Tick projects hundreds of silent memories: Meera repairing his ear, laughing in rain, writing MOON on her palm.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “He can’t hold all of me alone.”

shots.visual_event: The twelve bridge witnesses return and each learns one true memory of Meera, accepting that they may lose something else.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nurse: “I’ll remember the warning at the door.”

shots.visual_event: Countdown reaches zero. The city forgets Meera, but twelve witnesses speak their chosen memories and her outline becomes solid again.
On the train, every locked door displays Meera’s turquoise hair clip symbol; Arin hears the city speak her name.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “She found a payment the train didn’t steal.”

end_card.text: MEMORY CAN BE GIVEN — NOT ONLY TAKEN
